sn56.12:1.1: Idaṃ dukkham ariyasaccan ti bhikkhave tathāgatānam pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhum udapādi ñāṇam udapādi paññā udapādi vijjā udapādi āloko udapādi || ||
sn56.12:1.2: Taṃ kho panidaṃ dukkham ariyasaccam pariññeyyan ti bhikkhave tathāgatānam pubbe || la-pe ||
sn56.12:1.3: pariññātan ti bhikkhave tathāgatānam pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhum udapādi || pe || āloko udapādi || || 3.
sn56.12:2.1: Idaṃ dukkhasamudayam ariyasaccan ti bhikkhave tathāgatānam pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhum udapādi || pe || āloko udapādi || ||
sn56.12:2.2: Taṃ kho panidaṃ dukkhasamudayam ariyasaccam pahātabban ti bhikkhave tathāgatānam pubbe ||
sn56.12:2.3: la || pahīnan ti bhikkhave tathāgatānam pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhum udapādi || pe || āloko udapādi || || 4.
sn56.12:3.1: Idaṃ dukkhanirodham ariyasaccan ti bhikkhave Tathāgatanam pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhum udapādi || pe || āloko udapādi || ||
sn56.12:3.2: Taṃ kho panidaṃ dukkhanirodham ariyasaccam sacchikātabban ti tathāgatānam pubbe la-pe ||
sn56.12:3.3: sacchikatan ti bhikkhave tathāgatānam pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhum udapādi || pe || āloko udapādi || || 5.
sn56.12:4.1: Idaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ariyasaccan ti bhikkhave tathāgatānam pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhum udapādi ñāṇam udapādi paññā udapādi vijjā udapādi āloko udapādi || ||
sn56.12:4.2: Taṃ kho panidaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ariyasaccam bhāvetabban ti bhikkhave tathāgatānam pubbe || la-pe ||
sn56.12:4.3: bhāvitan ti bhikkhave tathāgatānam pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhum udapādi ñāṇam udapādi paññā udapādi vijjā udapādi āloko udapādī
